provenance: observed: Landsat 8 OLI/TIRS, 28 June 2019, Glasgow city boundary
analysis_scope: Daytime surface-UHI intervention screening, not causal prediction, air temperature or health-risk measurement.
lst_method: Single-channel LST from TIRS band 10: TOA radiance -> brightness temperature -> NDVI-based emissivity (vegetation proportion) -> Sobrino correction, processed in ENVI 5.6
classification: Supervised maximum-likelihood classification (built-up, water, forest, grassland) from Landsat 8 OLI
boundary_note: City boundary used for clipping only; not redistributed
